description: JavaScript functions for managing cookies, including get, set, delete, and sub-cookie handling, used within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: Get_Cookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie by name.

methods.name: Set_Cookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie with specified parameters such as name, value, expiration, path, domain, and security.

methods.name: Delete_Cookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration date to a past date.

methods.name: get_sub_cookies
methods.description: Parses a cookie string into a key-value object of sub-cookies.

methods.name: subs_to_cookie
methods.description: Converts a key-value object of sub-cookies into a cookie string.
